## Royal Gold Provides Preliminary Financial Information and Details for the Release of Financial Results for the Third Quarter 2026


10/20/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 182 KB](https://s28.q4cdn.com/583965976/files/Q3-2026-Pre-Quarter-Release-FINAL-Oct-20-2026-LH.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**Royal Gold, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGLD)** (together with its subsidiaries, “Royal Gold,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) announced preliminary financial information and details for the release of results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 ("third quarter").


**Preliminary Third Quarter Estimates**

1 Estimates are preliminary and are subject to change. See "Cautionary Note Regarding Preliminary Financial Information."


2 Gold Equivalent Ounces ("GEOs") are calculated as Royal Gold’s revenue (in total or by reportable segment) divided by the average London PM gold fixing price for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, of $4,262 per ounce.


3 Royalty Segment Sales and DD&A are presented as estimated ranges as final receipts are not yet available.


**Notable Third Quarter Financial Items**


Notable financial items for the third quarter include:


- The repayment of $250 million of debt, resulting in an outstanding balance on the revolving credit facility of $150 million on September 30, 2026, leaving $1.25 billion undrawn and available.
- The repurchase of 190,045 shares at an average price of $259.83 per share, for total consideration of $49 million. The repurchased shares were cancelled.


**Details for Release of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


Royal Gold's results for the third quarter will be released after the market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, followed by a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time (10:00 a.m. Mountain Time). The call will be webcast live and archived on the Company's website for a limited time.

**Corporate Profile**


Royal Gold is a high-margin, large-capitalization company that generates strong cash flows from a large and well-diversified portfolio of precious metal streams, royalties and similar production-based interests located in mining-friendly jurisdictions. Royal Gold shares trade under the symbol “RGLD” and provide growth, value, and income investors exposure to the metals & mining industry. The Company’s website is located at[www.royalgold.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.royalgold.com&esheet=54625196&newsitemid=20261020056712&lan=en-US&anchor=www.royalgold.com&index=2&md5=8a0bdb66735401deb72346990219c466) .
